reports.name: revenue_by_store
reports.semantic_sql: SELECT stores.name AS store_name, order_count, revenue FROM SEMANTIC jaffle GROUP BY stores.name
reports.comment: Revenue and order counts under this model revision, by store.

columns.name: revenue
columns.comment: Revenue in USD under the attached definition.

reports.name: monthly_summary
reports.semantic_sql: SELECT stores.name AS store_name, orders.order_month AS month, order_count, item_count, revenue, tax FROM SEMANTIC jaffle GROUP BY stores.name, orders.order_month
reports.comment: Monthly order and line counts, revenue and tax at each store. Facts aggregate independently.

reports.name: store_revenue
reports.semantic_sql: SELECT stores.name AS store_name, order_count, revenue FROM SEMANTIC jaffle WHERE stores.name = $store_name AND orders.order_day >= $start_day AND orders.order_day < $end_day GROUP BY stores.name

parameters.name: store_name
parameters.comment: Exact store display name, for example Philadelphia.

reports.comment: One store and a half-open date interval; all parameters are required.
